independenceLimits: Resized guide images, DVD screenshots and differently cropped collages often reuse the same underlying render; they are not independent source frames.
Two mannequin arts are different poses from the same archived model art collection, not independent capture sessions or measured animation frames.
Only Creeper overhead geometry was found; side/belly and original motion remain unvalidated.
No original animation FPS, contact timecode or frame cadence measured. All selected images are references, not delivered game sprites.
Normal Midwich references must not be substituted for midwich_nightmare or the 2006 film school; Otherworld screenshots19/21 remain excluded from the normal scene.
A frontal side-view fighting stage reconstructed from perspective screenshots is a candidate adaptation; not an exact source camera or measured architectural plan.

stage.limits: Wide versus viewpoint reconstructed from door/siding/slab screenshots and map. Facade extent, fence length and paving layout are extrapolated; no original camera or animation timing reproduced. Piano scene is not composited into courtyard.

excludedCandidates.reason: Four, then three feet instead of the source two feet and two closed upper appendages. Neither candidate imported. Final localized correction refused by image tool under sexual; no retry or workaround performed.

visualReview: Source anatomy, complete silhouettes, weapons and alpha margins inspected. Nurse remains frontal three-quarter; its +1 facing is a presentation choice. Creeper remains overhead because no source underside was obtained. Smoothness and faint alpha halos remain candidate limitations.
timingProvenance: Three static actor poses and one static background. No source capture FPS or animation timecodes measured.
